# Reports

This folder holds foundational reports, clinical tools, and academic publications that drive the quality development and patient education frameworks for atrial fibrillation care in Denmark. It contains the official 2023 annual quality report from the national registry, which tracks epidemiological trends and clinical indicators, alongside the Ambuflex questionnaire used to tailor individualized patient education. Additionally, it archives pivotal evidence-base publications, including a 2020 meta-analysis and 2019 national guidelines, which justify structured patient education and cardiac rehabilitation as core, life-saving components of treatment.

## Pages

- [[afdk-aarsrapport-2023|Årsrapport 2023]] — The official 2023 annual quality report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, detailing treatment indicators, epidemiological data, and regional variations in care.
- [[ambuflex-skema|Ambuflex-skema]] — A clinical questionnaire used as the foundation for individualized patient education in atrial fibrillation clinics prior to appointments.
- [[palm-et-al-2020|"Palm et al., 2020"]] — A pivotal 2020 meta-analysis demonstrating a significant reduction in death and hospital readmissions through structured patient education for atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[risom-2019|"Risom, 2019"]] — A publication supporting the Danish National Clinical Guidelines' strong recommendation for cardiac rehabilitation and patient education for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients.
